description: Reified 'Identifier' collection (WP2.3): a group of related fields modelled as its own Subject.

Identifier.description: This field is used to record an identifier attributed to the documented entity .

Identifier Type.description: This field is used to record the type of the identifier attributed to the documented person.

Source Reference Work for Identifier.description: This field is used to link to a source text in which the identifier denoting the documented entity is used.
